svg.title: The finite DAG is a mathematical input, not a controller that can inspect the hidden label. At a node i with t trials left, its action is one rational unit direction ai = (ci, si) and its three outcome edges lead to nodes ji,o with t −1 trials left. At t = 0, the node stores a sign di. With R(h) the nominated sign, define r0,i,h(v) = 1{di ̸= R(h)}, rt,i,h(v) = ∑︂ o∈{+,−,0} Kv(o | h, ai)rt−1,ji,o,h(v).
